title: Boyhood work and his birth date
summary: He worked around a grocery store as a boy; gives his birth date as July 19, 1894.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: And when you were a boy, did you do any work on the farm there?
Uh, well, I was, uh, I would work by a grocery store.
Oh, you know, I forgot to ask just when you were born, too. We didn't ask that to get your birthday.
You want that right now? Yeah, you might as well put it in that, how we think of it.
Yeah. I was born in July. July the 19th, 1894.
